gates.name: well-formed store
gates.claimStatusBasis: parse issues, integrity issues and a replay probe are all checked on the store as it exists
gates.supportBasis: parse, integrity and replay are fixed obligations checked against the store

gates.name: role mapping determined per construction, per grammar
gates.evidence: experimental/grant: survivors=1/6, labels=2 (floor 2); experimental/hand-over: survivors=1/6, labels=2 (floor 2); experimental/receive: survivors=1/6, labels=2 (floor 2); reporting/wei-quote: survivors=1/6, labels=9 (floor 2); reporting/wen-quote: survivors=1/6, labels=6 (floor 2); reporting/gao-quote: survivors=1/6, labels=4 (floor 2); reporting/yu-quote: survivors=1/6, labels=3 (floor 2); reporting/wen-plain: survivors=1/2, labels=3 (floor 2); reporting/gao-plain: survivors=1/2, labels=3 (floor 2); reporting/yue-quote: survivors=1/2, labels=2 (floor 2)
gates.claimStatusBasis: per-construction survival is read from the operational core, and every declared construction is probed
gates.supportBasis: the mapping survives because supervised labels eliminated the other permutations

gates.name: generalises when its own evidence is held out, per grammar
gates.evidence: experimental: core 6, accuracy=1, failures=0; reporting: core 14, accuracy=1, failures=0
gates.claimStatusBasis: leave-one-out over the operational core; each held-out record is re-read without itself
gates.claimStatusBounds: the core, not the whole store — records held out of the core are not re-read
gates.supportBasis: accuracy is computed from held-out labelled records

gates.name: fails closed outside the grammar
gates.claimStatusBasis: six declared negatives must all return Unknown
gates.claimStatusBounds: exactly those six sentences; nothing else is tested for failing closed
gates.supportBasis: six declared negatives are a fixed obligation: each must return Unknown

gates.name: grounded in the target corpus
gates.evidence: wenyan.relations.v1: 0/217362 (0, evidence 6); wenyan.relations.reporting.v1: 35918/217362 (0.165245, evidence 14) — floor 0.01, best grammar wenyan.relations.reporting.v1
gates.claimStatusBasis: a coverage rate measured over the corpus by running each declared grammar over every passage
gates.claimStatusBounds: one corpus build; a rebuild moves the denominator
gates.supportBasis: a coverage rate over one corpus build; it is a ratio, not a proof

gates.name: durable and re-derivable
gates.evidence: 49 record(s), 12 retracted (12 retraction record(s)); content hashes verified; corpus-derived sources verified=31/31
gates.claimStatusBasis: record and retraction hashes are recomputed, and corpus-derived sources are re-matched by TEXT
gates.claimStatusBounds: text equality, not label truth — a record can verify and still be wrong (see conflation C5)
gates.supportBasis: hashes recomputed and source text re-matched — text presence, not label truth

gates.name: dialogue contract exists and is enforced
gates.evidence: contract=wenyan.dialogue.contract.v1, 7 question type(s), 8 invariant(s) each naming its enforcement, out-of-scope declared: Q6, recorded contract violations=0
gates.claimStatusBasis: the contract file is read and its invariants are required to name an enforcer; nothing is measured
gates.supportBasis: structural conformance of the contract file

gates.name: declared questions answer the frozen reference corpus
gates.evidence: reference-corpus answer rate 0.246656 under wenyan.relations.reporting.v1 over 81575 reference passage(s) [frozen: knowledge/grammar/reference-corpus.json]; floor 0.15. DIAGNOSTIC, not the gate: live corpus rate 0.131501 — it moves when books are acquired, which is not grammar progress
gates.claimStatusBasis: a rate measured over one corpus build under the declared questions; the floor is 0.15, which is 61% of the measured ceiling
gates.claimStatusBounds: one corpus build; the aspirational target 0.5 is NOT met — a PASS here means progress, not arrival (see floors.mjs g8-corpus-answerability)
gates.supportBasis: the answer rate over the corpus under the declared questions
gates.missing: the floor is a declared parameter and is not lowered to match the current value: answering a question about real text still fails for the large majority of passages

gates.name: every record accounted for: modelled, held out, out of grammar, or excluded by provenance
gates.evidence: wenyan.relations.v1: core 6/32 + held out 0 + out-of-grammar 0 + provenance-excluded 0 = 6/6 (provenance authored); wenyan.relations.reporting.v1: core 14/32 + held out 17 + out-of-grammar 0 + provenance-excluded 0 = 31/31 (provenance corpus)
gates.claimStatusBasis: a partition identity over a finite set: core + named held-out + declared out-of-grammar + provenance-excluded must equal the pool, checked by exhaustion over the actual records
gates.claimStatusBounds: the pool as loaded; the identity is arithmetic and admits no sampling error
gates.supportBasis: a partition identity over the finite record set, established by exhaustion

verdict.reversible: Because the network is replay(evidence), adding contradicting evidence can raise survivors above 1 and re-open G2. Maturity is not monotone.
